# A .py source is a load_inline submission: the command compiles the
# translation unit load_inline would assemble, with its flags, without
# importing the file. A fake nvcc records what it was given.
[!exec:sh] skip
[!exec:python3] skip
chmod 0755 nvcc

exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -torch $WORK/site sub.py
stdout 'sub.py:9$'
stdout '^sm_90a +entry +32 .*_Z5scalePf$'

# torch's implicit includes come first, then the sources joined as
# load_inline joins them.
exec cat unit
cmp unit want.cu

# The call's flags replace -flags; its -gencode architectures and -std
# replace the defaults; torch's defines, flags and include directories are
# added, with a stand-in for the header a CPU-only wheel lacks.
exec cat args
stdout '-std=c\+\+17 '
stdout '-gencode=arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a'
! stdout 'compute_90a'
stdout ' -O2 -lineinfo '
! stdout '-O3'
stdout '-DTORCH_EXTENSION_NAME=sub_ext -DTORCH_API_INCLUDE_EXTENSION_H'
stdout '-D__CUDA_NO_HALF_OPERATORS__ .*--expt-relaxed-constexpr'
stdout '-isystem \S*site/torch/include -isystem \S*site/torch/include/torch/csrc/api/include'
stdout '-isystem \S*/torchstub'

# With -exec the stand-in reaches the compiling host with the work
# directory, and the flag names its copy there.
chmod 0755 vm.sh
mkdir vm
exec cudacompilecheck -exec $WORK/vm.sh -remote-tmp $WORK/vm -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -torch $WORK/site sub.py
exec cat args
stdout '-isystem \S*/vm/cudacompilecheck-[0-9-]+/src/\S*/torchstub '

# A header the wheel has is not shadowed by the stand-in.
mkdir site/torch/include/c10/cuda/impl
cp sub.py site/torch/include/c10/cuda/impl/cuda_cmake_macros.h
exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -torch $WORK/site sub.py
exec cat args
! stdout torchstub

# -arch and -flags given on the command line still apply.
exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -torch $WORK/site -arch sm_90a -flags -G sub.py
exec cat args
stdout '-gencode=arch=compute_90a,code=sm_90a'
! stdout 'compute_100a'
stdout ' -O2 -lineinfo .*-G '

# Arguments are read statically; anything else is an error for that file,
# and the other sources are still checked.
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -torch $WORK/site fstring.py k.cu
stderr 'fstring.py: load_inline call at line 3: line 3: cannot evaluate JoinedStr statically'
stderr '1 of 2 sources did not compile'
stdout 'k.cu'
stdout 'FAIL: did not compile: load_inline call at line 3'
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -torch $WORK/site plain.py
stderr 'plain.py: no load_inline call'
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -torch $WORK/site noarch.py
stderr 'no -gencode or -arch in extra_cuda_cflags; give -arch'

# -torch is required and checked.
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc sub.py
stderr 'a .py source needs -torch'
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -torch $WORK sub.py
stderr 'no torch/include/torch/extension.h there'

# A compiler killed by SIGKILL is probably out of memory.
! exec cudacompilecheck -nvcc $WORK/nvcc -torch $WORK/site -D KILL sub.py
stderr 'probably out of memory on the compiling host'

-- vm.sh --
#!/bin/sh
# A stand-in for limactl shell: drop flock(1) and timeout(1).
[ "$1" = flock ] && shift 6
[ "$1" = timeout ] && shift 4
exec "$@"
-- nvcc --
#!/bin/sh
echo "$@" > $WORK/args
out=
prev=
for a in "$@"; do
	[ "$prev" = -o ] && out=$a
	case $a in -DKILL) kill -9 $$;; esac
	prev=$a
	last=$a
done
cp "$last" $WORK/unit
: > "$out"
cat $WORK/ptxas.txt >&2
-- ptxas.txt --
ptxas info    : 0 bytes gmem
ptxas info    : Compiling entry function '_Z5scalePf' for 'sm_90a'
ptxas info    : Function properties for _Z5scalePf
    0 bytes stack frame, 0 bytes spill stores, 0 bytes spill loads
ptxas info    : Used 32 registers, used 0 barriers
-- site/torch/include/torch/extension.h --
-- sub.py --
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load_inline

CPP = "void f();"
PRELUDE = "#define N 4\n"
KERNEL = r"""__global__ void scale(float* x) { x[0] *= N; }"""


def build():
    return load_inline(
        name="sub_ext",
        cpp_sources=CPP,
        cuda_sources=[PRELUDE + KERNEL, "// second\n"],
        functions=["f"],
        extra_cuda_cflags=["-O2", "-std=c++17", "-gencode", "arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a", "-lineinfo"],
    )
-- want.cu --
#include <torch/types.h>
#include <cuda.h>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#define N 4
__global__ void scale(float* x) { x[0] *= N; }
// second
-- fstring.py --
import torch.utils.cpp_extension as ext
N = 4
m = ext.load_inline(name="x", cpp_sources="", cuda_sources=f"#define N {N}", extra_cuda_cflags=["-arch=sm_90a"])
-- plain.py --
print("no extension here")
-- noarch.py --
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load_inline
load_inline(name="x", cpp_sources="", cuda_sources="", extra_cuda_cflags=["-O3"])
-- k.cu --
__global__ void k() {}
